notablePrerequisites: You have at least one experience counter.
description:
Activate Daxos by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit enchantment creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Archon of Sun's Grace, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit and Pegasus, adding {W}{B}.
The Spirit and Pegasus die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
